note: Bighorn NF campground in pine and aspen beside Owen Creek, 0.2 mi up FS Road 236 off the Bighorn Scenic Byway (US-14), about 5 mi S of Burgess Junction. Run by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov 233926: 7 non-electric back-in sites (002, 008 first-come), $18 2026-2028 ($10 second vehicle), vehicle limits 24-50 ft (6 of 7 take 34 ft+), hand-pump water, vault toilets, 14-day limit, sold Jun 11-Sep 20 2027. Not waterfront kept. Pin 107 m from site centroid.
flags: Fee conflict: FS page 'Single Site: $20 per night' vs recreation.gov $18 for 2026-2028 - recreation.gov written.

Phone: empty -> 307-431-7446 (recreation.gov: 'For facility specific information, please call (307) 431-7446' - concessionaire Rustic Freedom / Gallatin Canyon Campgrounds); managing office Tongue Ranger District / Supervisor's Office (307) 674-2600 (FS page).
